    02 / YOUR BUILD

    Attachments & assembly

    Ergonomics, recoil and compatibility are optimized together.
    Data, calculation & limitations

    Calculations use a saved export from tarkov.dev. The retrieval date does not guarantee that every value reflects the latest hotfix. Each attachment links to its wiki page for verification.

    Ergo maximizes ergonomics. Recoil minimizes the additive recoil modifier. Balanced treats the slider as an Ergo target on the 0–100 scale. An optional maximum attachment budget is a hard limit based on saved vendor RUB values; unknown-price parts cannot be used, and barter values are estimates. If that target is unreachable, it uses the highest achievable ergonomics and minimizes recoil at that value. Calculations use base stats and attachment modifiers, without ammunition, character skills, durability, folded stocks or situational bonuses. Your selected optic and magazine are required, with compatible mounts. Other optics and empty dedicated scope mounts are excluded. With no scope selected, the build uses iron sights and fills dedicated front/rear sight slots when available. The achievable maximum includes your selected optic and availability rules. Practical mounting is enabled by default: after calculating the reference build, it first avoids reviewed high-profile mounts and risers, prefers reviewed low-profile routes, then searches for fewer sight mounts within 4 Ergo and exactly the same recoil, keeping main weapon parts and the chosen scope. Among equally simple routes it prefers higher ergonomics, then lower weight. This can fall below the Balanced target. Disable the toggle for maximum stats. Equivalent alternatives preserve recorded stats and slot capabilities, introduce no extra recorded compatibility restrictions, and are validated against the whole build. Alternatives are rechecked after every swap. Tactical devices remain optional.

    Availability: Known Arena reward items are excluded by default from weapons, attachments, scopes, mounting paths and equivalent alternatives. Disable Exclude Arena unlocks to include them. Trader settings restrict attachments to recorded purchase and barter offers at your loyalty levels. Quest offers are included by default and can be excluded in Settings. Your selected weapon is treated as already owned. Barters are included by default and may be disabled in Settings. Flea Market items are included by default and can be disabled in Settings. Market eligibility and item unlock levels come from the saved export; player access is assumed. Live listings and parts from other purchased weapon bundles are not checked. Unknown vendor prices are never treated as free. Among builds with equivalent objective stats and part counts, eligible purchase offers and lower RUB-equivalent cost are preferred. Cash trader offers win a price tie over barters or Flea Market estimates. This does not check your account or stash. The reviewed ID list is shipped with the app; downloading new stats does not discover new unlock rules.

    “Optimum confirmed” or “Practical build confirmed” requires the optimizer to prove its objectives within the displayed mode and constraints. In-game compatibility depends on the completeness of the source data.

    Updates & saved results: Select Update database to request a download from tarkov.dev. The confirmation names the data and image hosts. Nothing is downloaded automatically on startup. Updates are validated and saved locally before activation; a failed or cancelled update keeps the previous database. Old calculated results are cleared after a data change. No build is calculated until you select Calculate build. There is currently no personal preset library; Copy list exports your current build. The shopping list groups the current build by eligible vendor or Flea Market and separates cash offers, barters and market estimates.

    Game and item images: Battlestate Games. Community data: tarkov.dev / The Hideout. Independent community tool, not operated by Battlestate Games.

    MAKE IT YOURS

    Choose your scope

    Pick the sight you want to use. The builder finds its mounts and optimizes the rest of the weapon around it.

    Only sights with a verified complete assembly are shown, using the current trader levels, Flea Market setting, magazine and suppressor settings. Compatible mounts must also be available. No scope defaults to iron sights. Scopes and mounts change ergonomics. Dedicated front/rear sight slots are filled when present; built-in iron sights do not appear as separate attachments.

    MAKE IT YOURS

    Choose your magazine

    Only magazines with a verified complete assembly for this weapon, selected sight and current settings are shown.

    Choosing a specific magazine overrides the automatic capacity target. Change your scope, suppressor or trader settings to explore other compatible combinations.

    YOUR WORKBENCH

    Settings

    Choose your colors and trader loyalty levels. Settings are saved on this computer and can be changed at any time.

    Appearance

    Original green stays the default. Preview a theme now; Save settings keeps it after restart.

    The selected weapon and its factory-preset parts are already owned. Additional attachments and adapters need an eligible trader offer or, when enabled, Flea Market availability. At low levels, some weapons or suppressed builds may be impossible. Turn this off to plan with unrestricted attachments.

    Choose one level per trader. Click the selected level again for not unlocked (no box selected).

    Enabled by default. Shows eligible trades and their required items. Barter values are estimates based on saved ingredient prices; you still need the exchange items.

    Enabled by default. Allows items that can be listed on the Flea Market, even without a trader offer. Assumes you have Flea Market access and meet the item unlock level shown in the list. Prices use saved 24h averages, not live listings. Turn off for trader and factory parts only.

    Enabled by default. Assumes the required quests are complete; trader level requirements still apply. Turn off to exclude all quest-locked offers.

    Prices and offers come from the saved tarkov.dev database. Update database refreshes them manually. Factory-preset parts are included with the selected weapon and need no additional purchase. Flea Market purchases use saved 24h average estimates when enabled; live listings and stock are not checked. Barter recipes are included; their RUB values are estimates, not cash prices. Fence has no guaranteed inventory; only recorded offers count. At equal Ergo and recoil, compatible handguard replacements with better heat and cooling come before weight and price only when neither thermal value worsens. Both values must be supplied; missing data is not assumed neutral. Other parts favor lower weight, then price, while Prefer lighter parts is on; turned off, factory parts and lower prices come first and weight decides between equal prices. Uses RUB equivalents for USD/EUR.

    LOCAL DATA · MANUAL UPDATE

    Update your database

    Download the latest available community export from tarkov.dev / The Hideout?

    • json.tarkov.devWeapon data, attachment stats, compatibility, cash and barter offers, ingredient values and English names.
    • assets.tarkov.devMissing or changed item images, saved for offline use.

    Item exports are roughly 20 MB before compression, plus any new images. No account is required. This is a manual download, not permission for background updates. Community data may lag behind an EFT patch.

    The current database stays active until the new data has been validated and saved. Cached build results are cleared after a data change.
